payload.purpose_context: The doc-kitty docsite must render the docs' Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams at build time, as DocFX does today, without letting a diagram fetch remote content. A self-hosted PlantUML server pinned by digest runs in SANDBOX mode beside the build, a canary check proves it refuses remote includes, and the ADR records that guarantee. DocFX keeps deploying with its own PlantUML path.
payload.purpose_tldr: Render every Mermaid and PlantUML diagram as a static SVG in the doc-kitty build, against a digest-pinned sandboxed PlantUML server (#6936)
